description: This PHP source file defines the OA_Dal_Statistics_Banner class, which provides methods to retrieve various statistics related to banners in an advertising system, including daily, hourly, publisher, and zone breakdowns.

classes.name: OA_Dal_Statistics_Banner
classes.description: Data Abstraction Layer class for banner statistics, extending OA_Dal_Statistics, providing methods to fetch banner-related statistics.

methods.name: getBannerDailyStatistics
methods.description: Returns daily statistics for a specific banner, broken down by day and hour.

methods.name: getBannerHourlyStatistics
methods.description: Returns hourly statistics for a specific banner, broken down by day and hour.

methods.name: getBannerPublisherStatistics
methods.description: Returns statistics for a specific banner, broken down by publisher.

methods.name: getBannerZoneStatistics
methods.description: Returns statistics for a specific banner, broken down by zone.
